tools.name: fetch_network_feed
tools.description: Fetch a single API Evangelist network feed by its slug, e.g. "apis", "posts", "policies". Returns the parsed JSON feed body. Use list_network_feeds first to discover the available slugs and their schemas.

tools.name: get_page_as_markdown
tools.description: Return the current page rendered as markdown. Reads the page's <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> source if present.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List the API Evangelist topic areas — focused subsites under *.apievangelist.com (documentation, security, agents, automation, aggregation, etc.). Returns the slug, display name, and URL for each.

tools.name: list_network_feeds
tools.description: List every machine-readable feed in the API Evangelist network (apis, posts, conversations, contracts, experiences, guidance, partners, policies, properties, rules, schema, standards, strategies, utilities, videos, vocabularies, spotlight-rules). Returns an RFC 9727 linkset describing each feed's anchor, service-desc (JSON feed), service-doc (developer-portal page), and service-meta (GitHub repo).
